hooks.command: jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c | if ($c | test("(^| )(grep|egrep|fgrep|rg|git|cat|less|head|tail) ")) then empty elif ($c | test("db[[:space:]]+reset")) and ($c | test("tests/e2e/review")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"That resets the review stand, which carries a clone of the live cluster plus the pending migrations — the acceptance stand and the migration rehearsal both live there, and a reset destroys both. Refresh it deliberately instead: cd tests/e2e && bun run review:stack -- --refresh"}} else empty end'

input=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); c=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // ""'); case "$f" in */apps/*/components/*.tsx|*/apps/*/app/*.tsx) if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '<(button|input|select|textarea)[ />]'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"@workspace/ui + ZM-first: recall() the placement convention BEFORE building. Generic/visible primitives (buttons, inputs, progress bars, dropzones) MUST live in packages/ui; apps hold only thin wrappers injecting infra via callbacks. This file has a raw <button>/<input> - confirm it belongs in packages/ui, not apps."}}'; fi ;; esac; exit 0
